You don't need to save the world! Just solve the incidents right in front of you, fixer!

A paradise where everything from bread theft cases to audacious prison break dramas runs rampant under dazzling neon lights!

Become a tough guy protagonist and shake the world alongside unique and beautiful girls!

Make Drama! A collectible RPG featuring animated direction and an immersive story!

■ Dazzling! A Harem Mayhem unfolding in a women-only world!
